section_header: MANUAL TRANSMISSION — Component Parts (Counter Gear and Reverse Idler Gear)
title: MEASURE CLEARANCE OF REVERSE IDLER GEAR AND SHIFT ARM SHOE
ocr_text:
MT-32    MANUAL TRANSMISSION — Component Parts (Counter Gear and Reverse Idler Gear)

2.    MEASURE CLEARANCE OF REVERSE IDLER GEAR AND
      SHIFT ARM SHOE
      Using a feeler gauge, measure the clearance between the
      reverse idler gear and shift arm shoe.
      Standard clearance:     0.20 — 0.41 mm
                              (0.008 — 0.0161 in.)
      Maximum clearance:      0.9 mm (0.0354 in.)
